title: Philly Coffee Tour Ticket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the vibrant coffee culture of Philadelphia on this engaging two-hour tour through Old City. Sample unique flavors at four distinct coffee stops, where local roasters showcase their creativity and passion. Enjoy beverage tastings at each location while learning about the coffee roasting process and the rich history of the area. With fun surprises along the way, this tour is perfect for coffee enthusiasts and casual drinkers alike. Choose from two ticket options to enhance your experience and take home a taste of Philly's coffee charm.
